title: Luthkar Madina Zainab Tashreef Larahi Hai
body:
Luthkar Madina Zainab Tashreef Larahi Hai
Turbat Pe Fatima Ki Aansu Baharahi Hai
1.Balou Se Muh Ku Apne Dukhiya Chuparahi Hai
Shaanou Ke Neel Maa Ku Zainab Dikharahi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Amma Main Berida Thi Balwe Me Aashqiyan Ke
Ahwal Sab Safar Ke Zainab Sunarahi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Turbat Pe Maa Ki Aayi Rudad-e-Gham Sunayi
Kurta Lahu Bhara Ek Maa Ku Dikharahi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Sar Pe Liye Hai Tuhfe Maidan-e-Karbala Ke
Mehshar Se Phele Meshar Zainab Utharahi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Khoram Ek Macha Hai Majlis Yahan Bapa Hai
Arsh-e-Bari Ku Zainab Rokar Hilarahi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Iqbal Kya Sunaye Zainab Ke Dil KI Halat
Mar Mar Ke Jeene Wali Jeena Sekharahi Hai
